plan.notes: Transcribed 2026-11-13 from the official Southern Utah University 2026-2027 General Catalog (current edition, catoid=28) History - History Education Emphasis program page (poid=10857) and its linked official degree map, 'History & History Education Degree Maps (2026-2027)', tab 'History Education (Campus)' (the workbook's Index lists Online as N/A for this emphasis), last updated/reviewed July 31, 2026. Semester placement is the university's official sample 4-year campus academic plan (SUU Program Maps, 2026-2027), which the source itself labels a guide only; students confirm specifics in Degree Works with a Student Success Advisor. Collected as the BS: the program is a combined BA/BS, the catalog prints a single combined Total Credits, BA/BS Degree: 120, and the map expressly states that students electing the BA take 16 credits of one foreign language, which are not included in the map; the BS version is recorded, following the prior-wave pattern for combined BA/BS programs. Every semester's courses sum to the map's printed semester total (15/15/15/16/16/16/15/12) and the plan to the catalog's printed Total Credits, BA/BS Degree with Licensure: 120. Per the catalog, students must earn a minimum grade of C (2.0) or better in all courses required for the major, HIST 3100, HIST 4990, HIST 3870 and SOSC 4900 must be taken in residence at SUU, and a maximum of 6 credits of lower-division electives may be applied toward the major; the degree leads to teacher licensure in the State of Utah. The catalog's History - History Education Curriculum (48 credits) is exercised by the map: History Core Requirements 12 (HIST 3100, HIST 4990, one United States History course - the map places HIST 2700 in Fall Year 2 - and the Traditionally Underrepresented Communities choice, exercised as the map's Fall Year 3 slot) and History Education Requirements 36 (HIST 1500, HIST 1510, HIST 3870, SOSC 4900, SOSC 4980 Student Teaching 9, the United States History course not taken in the Core - HIST 2710 in Spring Year 2 - and the History Electives block). The Professional Education Requirements for Secondary Licensure overlap the major as the catalog itself directs (its note states that methods and student-teaching credits completed in the major are counted only once): the Pre-Admission methods course is exercised as SOSC 4900, the Block Courses are SCED 3570 and SCED 3590 in Fall Year 4, and the Advanced Courses are exercised as EDUC 4930 and SOSC 4980 (the catalog's Academic 4980 Student Teaching) in Spring Year 4. DISCLOSED catalog discrepancy, not reconciled: the Professional Education Pre-Admission Courses block is headed 18-19 credits, but its listed items sum to 18-20 (SCED 3180 and the Academic 3900/4900 Methods Course(s) are each catalogued at 2-3 credits); the map places SCED 3180 at 2 credits, the value recorded here. DISCLOSED map coverage, not reconciled: the catalog's History Electives block totals 12 credits, of which the map labels three 3-credit upper-division rows (9 credits); the remaining 3 credits (the lower-division or upper-division portion) carry no separately labelled row on the map and sit within the map's free-elective rows as printed (the map's free-elective rows total 25 credits: 3/2/7/7/3/3). The map calls EDUC 4930 'Student Teaching Practicum'; the catalog title, Student Teaching Seminar, is recorded. The map prints a non-course marker, 'Apply to College of Education Teacher Preparation Program', in Fall Year 3 (not recorded as a course row), and notes that students who do not select HIST 1100/1110 or HIST 1700 for a General Education requirement must substitute three free-elective credits for a lower-division HIST course. Catalog course titles are recorded where the map shortens them.
